planets.name: TOI-1710 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1710 with a 24.3-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1710 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1710. Its orbit and size follow Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
